name: branding-settings
title: Branding settings
description: How a workspace looks to its customers: logos for light and dark, an icon and a brand colour with a contrast check, and live page and email previews.
docs: Images are URLs: onUpload receives the chosen file (only SVG and PNG get that far) and resolves to the address it can be shown from, and Save hands back the same four values. An address that turns out not to draw is taken back with a message, so a broken image is never saved. The colour is checked against white and black text (minContrast 4.5 is WCAG AA, 7 is AAA) and against a white page; one that fails is not applied and the reason is shown. colors sets the swatches. The previews are drawn on literal white, because they show the customer's page, not your product. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
